reviewNotes:
Allô Père Noël lets a parent prepare a pretend phone call from Santa for their child. Everything is simulated inside the app: it never places or receives real calls, never uses CallKit, the microphone, the camera or the network (except the App Store purchase).

How to test: tap "Prepare a magic call", type a first name (the letter says whether Santa says that name himself or his elf says it), pick up to two qualities, tap Continue, keep "The magic call" (free) and "Now", then tap "Start the call". An in-app incoming call screen rings; tap Answer. Santa appears full screen: it is an AI-generated portrait (FLUX.1 schnell, not a real person) animated on the device, his mouth follows the sound of his voice. His voice is pre-recorded synthetic speech bundled in the app (no real person's voice): fixed lines, and one greeting and one goodbye per common first name. What the parent typed (a proud moment, the Christmas wish) and uncommon first names are read by "the elf" with the device's built-in speech synthesis. Santa pauses so the child can answer (nothing is recorded), shows a star surprise and says goodbye. The end screen offers Replay, Create a keepsake (a card image shared with the iOS share sheet; photo access is only requested if the parent chooses Save Image) and Back to home.

Purchases, all behind a multiplication question for grown-ups, including before the privacy-policy link. Free tier: a preview of the magic call (greeting by name, age, qualities, a first question, goodbye by name; about 45 seconds), Santa's voice sample, and advent door 1. Christmas Pass (com.padelup.allonoel.pass, 6.99 EUR, non-consumable) unlocks the full calls, every story, calls for siblings, the elf's lines, the star surprise, the letter, the good-child certificate and the advent calendar. The earlier product com.padelup.allonoel.magie still unlocks the same Pass. Extra messages (com.padelup.allonoel.messages, 2.99 EUR, consumable) adds three shareable messages for another child. Open the Pass from the end of the preview, a locked story, the home screen or Settings. Restore is on the paywall and in Settings.

No account, no ads, no tracking, no data collection: the children's first names and details stay on the device and can be erased in Settings. The background melody is "Silent Night" (Franz Gruber, 1818, public domain), synthesized for the app. The font Fraunces is under the SIL Open Font License.
